ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'C_Q_Assessment', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Call_Letter_Review_Assessment'), ISBLANK(Related_Case__c) )
